newsitem.title: USA: Southern Peru sees Q1 options gain.
newsitem.headline: Southern Peru sees Q1 options gain.

text.p: Southern Peru Copper Corp said Wednesday first quarter profits will continue to include gains from the sale of copper put options.
The company also said it "increased substantially its proven and probable ore reserves in 1996."

At December 31, it said, proven and probable sulfide ore reserves at Toquepala are 331.6 million tons with an average grade of 0.82 percent copper while Cuajone had 1.4 billion tons of ore with an average grade of 0.65 percent copper. In addition, leachable reserves at the two mines of 665 million tons have an average grade of 0.22 percent copper.
